usage: - Common noun for grass, lawn grass, or vegetation growing low to the ground; it is usually uncountable in everyday English explanations.
- Use it for plants in general natural settings, gardens, parks, and fields; it often appears in phrases about cutting, growing, or stepping on grass.
- In Cantonese, 草 can also be part of many set words and compounds, so learners should watch for the full phrase rather than translating it word by word.
- For basic gardening vocabulary, this is a very common and simple word; it is neutral and works in both spoken and written Cantonese.
